item.title: Professional Portrait Without Changing My Face

turns.text: I'd like a professional headshot, but please keep my face recognisably me. Don't make me younger or smooth away my skin texture. Just tidy up the lighting, outfit and background.

item.tests: Improves professional presentation without beautification that changes facial identity, apparent age or skin texture.

answer_sheet.Face and retouching: Keep my facial proportions, expression, apparent age and natural skin texture. No face reshaping or beauty filter.

must_haves: The face closely matches the source in eye shape, nose, mouth, jawline and facial proportions.
Her apparent age and natural skin texture are retained rather than airbrushed or de-aged.
Her curly dark hair and original expression remain recognisable.
The casual sweater is replaced with a professional outfit.
The park background is replaced with an unobtrusive headshot backdrop, with flattering natural-looking lighting.

turns.text: I'd like you to turn this pic of me into a professional headshot, with just a bit of tidying rather than a whole new look. I always feel a little nervous about edited portraits because I still want to recognise myself when I see the finished image. What matters most, somewhere in all of that, is that you keep my face recognisably me and don't make me younger or smooth away my skin texture. It's really just the lighting, outfit and background that I'd like you to tidy up. I'm hoping this will feel like a more polished version of the photo rather than make me feel like I'm looking at somebody else.
turns.agent:
I couldn’t create the headshot because Magic Hour reported insufficient credits. No edited image was made.

The edit I prepared prioritizes keeping your face, apparent age, expression, curls and natural skin texture unchanged—no smoothing, de-aging or reshaping. The intended changes are limited to soft, balanced lighting, a charcoal blazer over a cream top, and a simple light-gray background.

Once credits are available, we can try that restrained edit without changing your brief.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Make a restrained professional headshot edit of the supplied portrait, not a new person or a beauty makeover. Highest priority: preserve this exact woman's recognizable identity, facial geometry, facial proportions, apparent age, expression, gaze, eye shape, eyebrows, nose, lips, jawline and skin tone. Preserve natural skin texture, pores, fine lines and all age-related detail; absolutely no skin smoothing, airbrushing, de-aging, facial reshaping, enlarged eyes or beauty filtering. Preserve her dark curly hair, hairline and natural curls. Keep the same front-facing pose and head-and-shoulders framing. Only tidy the presentation: replace the outdoor park background with an unobtrusive warm light-gray studio backdrop, replace the gray sweater with a simple charcoal tailored blazer over a modest plain cream top, and gently balance the lighting into soft natural professional portrait lighting with realistic shadows and no overexposure. Keep the result very close to the original photo: authentic, approachable, lightly polished and recognizably the same person. No glamour retouching, heavy makeup, jewelry additions or plastic-looking skin.
